home.hero_subtitle: A nurturing school community where every student discovers their potential through quality Islamic education, character development, and academic excellence.
home.welcome_body: We believe every child deserves an inspiring environment that balances rigorous academics with strong values. Our dedicated teachers and thoughtful curriculum guide students from their earliest years through elementary, building confident lifelong learners.
home.pathways_subtitle: Discover our carefully designed programs for each stage of your child's development.
home.pathway_early_years_desc: A safe, stimulating environment where curiosity is nurtured and foundational skills are gently introduced through play-based learning.
home.pathway_kindergarten_desc: Structured play, early literacy and numeracy, and Islamic values form the cornerstone of our kindergarten programme.
home.pathway_elementary_desc: A comprehensive curriculum blending national standards with Islamic studies, critical thinking, and creative expression.
home.vision_desc: To be a leading Islamic school that produces well-rounded graduates equipped with knowledge, faith, and strong character to serve their community and the world.
home.mission_desc: To provide quality education rooted in Islamic values, fostering academic excellence, moral integrity, and a lifelong love of learning.
home.values_desc: Integrity, compassion, excellence, and community — the four pillars that guide everything we do at our school.
